---
name: playbook-fix
description: Use when a bug is small. Opens one PR.
---

This is the playbook `/fix` command for Codex. Run it as `$playbook-fix`. The text after the skill name is `$ARGUMENTS`. Where a step names the `Agent` tool, `subagent_type`, `SendMessage` or `AskUserQuestion` and they are not available, do that step yourself or ask in chat.

# Fix

If it is not small, hand off to `$playbook-plan`.
Follow playbook-writing-style and read ../playbook-writing-style/SKILL.md.
Ask with AskUserQuestion.
